occupations.title: Software Developers
occupations.shortage_evidence: Intense shortage of experienced developers skilled in cloud microservices, REST APIs, and automated CI/CD pipelines; severe cross-border brain drain to Singapore and remote overseas employers.

occupations.title: Systems Analysts & Solutions Architects
occupations.shortage_evidence: High demand for business process re-engineering, legacy migration, enterprise architecture, and human-in-the-loop workflow redesign.

occupations.title: Database Designers & Administrators
occupations.shortage_evidence: Exponential data growth requiring high-concurrency SQL optimization, data warehouse governance, and compliance with data privacy mandates.

occupations.title: Database & Network Professionals NEC (Data Scientists & AI Engineers)
occupations.shortage_evidence: Massive demand surge driven by national AI roadmap, corporate GenAI pilots, predictive analytics, and machine learning deployment.

occupations.title: Software & Applications Developers & Analysts NEC (Full-Stack & Cloud Engineers)
occupations.shortage_evidence: Crucial shortage of engineers capable of building scalable web applications, API integrations, and cloud-native services.

occupations.title: Systems Administrators & Cloud Infrastructure Engineers
occupations.shortage_evidence: Hyperscale data center boom in Johor and Cyberjaya creating acute shortage of cloud infrastructure, virtualization, and carbon-aware telemetry engineers.

occupations.title: Accountants & Financial Auditors
occupations.shortage_evidence: Persistent shortage of qualified chartered accountants; rapid transition towards automated financial closing and mandatory Bursa Malaysia ESG sustainability disclosures.

occupations.title: Management & Organization Analysts (Business Transformation Consultants)
occupations.shortage_evidence: High corporate demand for organizational restructuring, post-merger integration, ESG alignment, and AI change management.

occupations.title: Policy & Corporate Planning Professionals
occupations.shortage_evidence: Urgent requirement for regulatory compliance, National Energy Transition Roadmap (NETR) alignment, and AI governance policymaking.

occupations.title: Electrical Engineers
occupations.shortage_evidence: Grid modernization, high-voltage infrastructure, and solar farm integration under the National Energy Transition Roadmap.

occupations.title: Electronic Engineers (Semiconductor IC Design & Testing)
occupations.shortage_evidence: National Semiconductor Strategy (NSS) targeting 60,000 high-skilled engineers; intense competition for analog/digital IC design and advanced packaging specialists.

occupations.title: Environmental Engineers & Sustainability Analysts
occupations.shortage_evidence: Newly critical occupation driven by carbon pricing mechanisms, mandatory Scope 1-3 greenhouse gas accounting, and EU CBAM trade compliance.

occupations.title: Training & Staff Development Professionals (Reskilling Strategists)
occupations.shortage_evidence: Rising demand for corporate reskilling architects able to design modular adult learning pathways under HRD Corp and TVET national agendas.

occupations.title: Graphic & Multimedia Designers (UI-UX & Digital Product Designers)
occupations.shortage_evidence: Surge in digital self-service platforms requiring human-centred interface design, design system maintenance, and generative AI creative workflows.

occupations.title: Information and Communications Technology Services Managers
occupations.shortage_evidence: Leadership deficit in guiding enterprise digital transformation, cloud migrations, AI governance compliance, and cybersecurity resilience.

occupations.title: Web Technicians & Cloud Application Operators
occupations.shortage_evidence: Support technicians needed to maintain web endpoints, test API integrations, and manage cloud portal deployments.

occupations.title: Commercial Sales Representatives (Technical & B2B Solutions)
occupations.shortage_evidence: Technical sales roles requiring domain knowledge in enterprise software, industrial robotics, and engineering components.
